calls.statement:
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory,
       SUM(f.quantity) AS units, COUNT(*) AS line_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id = 102
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY units DESC
LIMIT 10

calls.statement:
WITH f AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date, f.quantity, f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.net_amount, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
), a AS (
  SELECT sale_date, SUM(quantity) u, SUM(net_amount) n, COUNT(*) c, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dc, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) drl,
         SUM(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) zz
  FROM f GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.sale_date, a.u, a.zz, a.c, a.dc, a.drl, a.n, r.units_sold, r.net_sales_before_returns, r.returns_net
FROM a FULL JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=a.sale_date AND r.store_id=102
WHERE COALESCE(a.sale_date, r.business_date) BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
ORDER BY 1

WITH sold AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(f.quantity) units, MIN(f.quantity) minq, COUNT(DISTINCT f.product_key) versions
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1),
ret AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.quantity_returned) rq
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1),
ret_in_period AS (
  SELECT p.sku, SUM(r.quantity_returned) rq_period
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT sold.sku, sold.units, sold.minq, sold.versions, COALESCE(ret.rq,0) returned_of_these_sales, COALESCE(ret_in_period.rq_period,0) returned_in_period,
 (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT product_name, ' / ') FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=sold.sku) names
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret USING (sku) LEFT JOIN ret_in_period USING (sku)
ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 6
